name: us022-switch-to-subtask
description: Switching a project from checklist back to subtask mode: re-binding by preserved identifier, not duplicating (contract §8 case 4).

write..specify/jira/config.yml:
# Minimal team config for the task-tier reconcile integration suite
# (012, T042/T043). A `task` role is declared and resolved into the binding
# below, alongside the specification and story roles.
projects:
  - key: TASKP
    style: company_managed
    priority_map:
      P1: Highest
      P2: Medium
      P3: Low
routing_default: TASKP
